headline.title: Catch up on 12 major I/O 2026 moments
headline.summary: The article highlights 12 significant moments from the I/O 2026 keynote, showcasing key announcements and developments presented during the event. It features a visual representation of the I/O logo alongside images capturing the essence of the keynote presentations.

articles.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot gets a speed boost and cleaner design
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced an updated version of Microsoft 365 Copilot featuring a cleaner design and improved performance, reportedly loading twice as fast. The update aims to enhance user experience by providing more reliable and structured responses that are easier to scan, and it will be available on both desktop and mobile devices.

articles.title: Anthropic raises $65 billion, nears $1T valuation ahead of IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic has successfully raised $65 billion in a Series H funding round, achieving a post-money valuation of $965 billion. This funding is likely the company's last private round before its expected initial public offering (IPO).

articles.title: Asana acquires no-code agent-builder Stack AI
articles.summary: Asana has acquired Stack AI, a no-code agent-builder, to enhance its suite of AI workflow tools. This integration aims to improve user capabilities in automating tasks and workflows within the Asana platform.

articles.title: In just 3 weeks, StrictlyVC is coming to Los Angeles
articles.summary: StrictlyVC Los Angeles will take place on June 18, featuring networking opportunities and fireside chats with leaders from companies like Mach Industries and Shinkei Systems. Interested participants are encouraged to register for the event.

articles.title: Anthropic releases Opus 4.8 with new ‘dynamic workflow’ tool
articles.summary: Anthropic has released Opus 4.8, featuring a new tool called Dynamic Workflows, which enables the coordination of swarms of subagents. This update aims to enhance the model's efficiency and functionality in managing complex tasks.

articles.title: A $2,000 AI-generated film will make its debut at Tribeca
articles.summary: The Tribeca Festival will feature the premiere of "Dreams of Violets," a 75-minute AI-generated film that dramatizes the Iranian government's mass killing of protestors in January. The film was created entirely with AI technology and had a production cost of $2,000.

articles.title: These new iOS 27 renders hint at Siri’s big redesign
articles.summary: New renders from Bloomberg suggest that Apple's Siri will undergo a significant redesign in iOS 27, featuring an interface reminiscent of ChatGPT and incorporating a Liquid Glass aesthetic. The visuals provide a preview of the anticipated app and chat interface for the voice assistant.

articles.title: Just like gold and oil, we’ll soon be able to trade AI token futures
articles.summary: Major exchanges are developing derivative products for AI tokens, positioning them as tradable assets similar to gold and oil. This shift reflects a growing recognition of AI tokens as essential raw materials in the digital economy.

articles.title: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Databricks’ co-founder on what kills enterprise AI deals
articles.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Databricks’ co-founder discussed the evolving landscape of enterprise AI, highlighting that companies are shifting their focus from the excitement of AI to concerns about its safety for widespread deployment. This transition marks a critical phase in the evaluation of AI solutions within enterprises.

articles.title: 2 days left: Lock in ticket savings of up to $410 to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.summary: Ticket savings of up to $410 for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will end on May 29 at 11:59 p.m. PT. The event is scheduled to take place from October 13-15 in San Francisco, expecting over 10,000 tech leaders to attend.

articles.title: Claude’s new model is more ‘honest’ when it messes up
articles.summary: Anthropic is set to release Claude Opus 4.8, emphasizing the model's improved honesty in acknowledging its mistakes. The company aims to enhance the reliability of its AI by training models to avoid unsupported claims and reduce the tendency to jump to conclusions.
